t: Shello lebarek kesheabarayv roim et haerva
s: Shello lebarek kesheabarayv roim et haerva ubo z' seipim: katub battora: "veshabta vekissita veku', ki Hashem eloheka mithallek beqereb machaneka vego', vehaya machaneka qadosh, velo yireh beka ervat dabar vego'". Mikkan lamedu chakamim shebbekol meqom sheHashem elohenu mithallek immanu, dehaynu kesheanu oseqim biqriat shema ubitpilla o bedibre tora — tzarik lihyot hammachaneh qadosh, shello tehe tzoa megulla sham, veshello yireh Hashem banu ervat dabar, dehaynu shello yihyeh debar erva keneged panayv shel adam haqqore o mitpallel kimlo enayv, mippene sheiqqar machanehu shel adam hu keneged panayv, vetzarik sheyyihyeh machaneh zeh qadosh, shello yireh bo Hashem ervat dabar. Veissur zeh hu min hattora. Vehachakamim hosipu shehammeqomot asher Hashem shoken bahem beqirbenu, shehem rosho velibbo shel adam haqqore o mitpallel — tzarik gam ken shello yihyu roim et haerva, dehaynu shello yihyeh im haerva tachat mikseh echad beli hepseq vachatzitza benehem (ap al pi shemmin hattora en bazeh mishshum "velo yireh beka" ku', kevan sheervato mekussa neged bene adam). Lepikak im haya yashen arom umitkasseh betallito, ap al pi shehotzi rosho chutz letallito shello yihyeh im ervato tachat mikseh echad — hare zeh lo yiqra ad sheyyachotz betallito al libbo lehapsiq ben libbo laerva, shellibbo roeh et haerva asur. Vehu haddin im libbo roeh et ervat chabero, dehaynu sheen hepseq ben libbo leervat chabero, kegon sheshshenehem shokebim arummim umitkassim betallit echad vehem rechoqim zeh mizzeh sheen besaram nogea ella sheppenehem zeh keneged zeh:

Apillu im libbo mekusseh bebeged lehapsiq beno laerva — tzarik shettehe ervato gam ken mekussa. Veim hu megulleh — asur liqrot min hattora, apillu im hechezir panayv mimmenna shello yirenna o sheatzam enayv, shehare lo neemar "lo tireh ervat dabar", ella "lo yireh beka", kelomar shettehe mekusseh beinyan shello tehe nireh leacher haomed etzlo. Lepikak haomed babbayit arom vehotzi rosho chutz lachallon shello yireh ervato, ap al pi shekkissa libbo bebeged — hare zeh lo yiqra, kevan sheervato migulla veniret babbayit. Abal hayyashen arom bekilla sheeno gaboah y' tepachim vehotzi rosho chutza lah vegam kissa bebeged al libbo, ap al pi sheervato migulla bakkilla — hare zeh kimkusseh betallit, shekkevan sheen hakkilla gaboah y' tepachim shem kissuy aleha, veenah doma lebayit shehu chaluq reshut leatzmo, vekevan shehaerva niret betoko — asur:

Mayim apillu hen tzelulin chashubim kissuy laerva, ubilbad sheyyotzi rosho velibbo chutz lammayim, shello yihyeh im ervato tachat mikseh echad kemo shennitbaer saip a'. Veim libbo tok hammayim, im hem tzelulim — asur mishshum libbo roeh et haerva. Veim hen akurim sheen abarayv nirim bahem — muttar liqrot betokam, vehu mippene shehem chashubim hepseq ben libbo laerva. Vehu shello yihyeh recham ra, sheaz tzarik leharchiq mehem d' ammot kemo sheyyitbaer leqamman. Umayim tzelulim sheal gabbe qarqa okeran beraglayv umuttar. Veharochetz bemayim tzelulim shebbakkeli shei epshar leokran verotzeh lishtot, im libbo tok hammayim — yekasseh babbeged mimmatta lelibbo vibarek. Abal im kissahu beyado — eno chashub kissuy, shehalleb vehayyad gup echad hen veen haggup yakol lekassot et atzmo. Vehu haddin im mekasseh et rosho beyadayv — eno chashub kissuy sheyyukal lebarek kak begilluy harosh, kemo sheyyitbaer leqamman besiman tz"a:
Im haadam mechabbeq gupo bizrootayv — hare zeh chashuba hapsaqa ben libbo laerva, sheap shehayyad enah chashuba kissuy — chashuba hapsaqa, kevan shemmikkol maqom en libbo roeh et haerva:

Yesh omerim shehannashim yekolot lebarek ulehitpallel keshehen lebushot hechaluq ap al pi sheenan mapsiqot lematta millibban, lepi sheervatan lematta meod veen libbam roeh et haerva. Umikkol maqom im hen arummot, kevan sheervatan migulla veniret laacherim — asur mishshum "velo yireh beka ervat dabar vego'". Veim hi yoshebet sheaz en paneha shel matta niret — mutteret lebarek ap al pi shehi arumma, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman r"v:

Shear abarayv roim et haerva — muttar. Abal im ezeh meabarayv nogea beervato o beervat chabero — asur liqrot o lehitpallel. Veyaryakotayv shehaerva shokebet alehen — tzarik lehapsiqan bebeged, o leharchiqan beinyan shello yigga haggid bahen. Abal bakkis en lachush im nogea bahen, lepi shello aseru abarayv nogeim beervato ella mishshum gezera attu yado nogaat beervato sheaz yabo lide hirhur, lepikak bakkis sheen lachush bo mishshum hirhur ap im hayeta nogaat bo — en ligzor bo mishshum abarayv roim et haerva, ap al pi shehu erva gemura leinyan sheim hu megulleh asur liqrot kenegdo mishshum "velo yireh beka vego'":

Hayeta tallito chagura lo al motnayv lekassoto mimmotnayv ulematta, ap al pi shemmimmotnayv ulemala hu arom — muttar liqrot qeriat shema, kevan sheervato mekussa, vegam hattallit mapseqet ben libbo laerva. Abal lehitpallel asur ad sheyyekasseh libbo, lepi shebbattepilla tzarik lirot et atzmo keomed lipne hammelek umedabber immo shetztzarik laamod beema, abal biqriat shema eno medabber im hammelek:
